expectedError.message: Returning bool from comparison function is deprecated

observations.expectedError: must be greater than or equal to 1
Indirect modification of Temperature::$celsius is not allowed
Instantiation of class Closure is not allowed

observations.rule: PSR-4 section 2.3: namespace prefix maps to base directory; subnamespace and class filename match case.

optionAudit.full-prefix: Adds a directory already accounted for by the prefix mapping
optionAudit.mapped: Matches the prefix and both case-sensitive segments

observations.rule: Atomic order/outbox commit closes the lost-intent crash window; broker publication remains at least once, not exactly once.

optionAudit.publish-before: Can publish an event for rolled-back work
optionAudit.commit-publish: Crash gap after commit loses intent
optionAudit.outbox: Durable same-transaction intent plus retry meets the stated contract

observations.rule: Given interleaved operations and shared mutable storage, job-specific values can be overwritten; separate immutable call contexts avoid that shared location.

optionAudit.explicit-context: Each call retains its own immutable identity
optionAudit.constructor-user: One user is reused for later jobs
optionAudit.global-reset: Interleaving still races through the global

observations.rule: PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface::withAttribute retains immutability; PSR-15 handler consumes the request passed to handle.

optionAudit.discard-return: Original instance has no new attribute

observations.rule: A nested catch can isolate a secondary throwable; throwing original preserves object identity, unlike wrapping or throwing from finally.

optionAudit.guard-log: Both logging branches propagate the same original object
optionAudit.finally-log: A secondary throwable can replace the primary
optionAudit.boolean-fallback: Caller receives a value rather than the required throwable

observations.rule: Composer install uses composer.lock; --no-dev excludes development requirements; check-platform-reqs checks the real platform.
session_write_close writes session data and ends the active session, releasing the file-handler lock under the stated configuration.

optionAudit.regenerate: Does not implement the required early session close
optionAudit.close-early: Releases the lock before independent work
optionAudit.close-late: Retains the lock throughout the slow calculation

observations.rule: Cache correctness requires identical keys to imply identical relevant inputs under the stated decision function.
Given ambiguous commit and atomic unique operation records, authoritative outcome resolution plus stable operation identity distinguishes success from retryable absence.

optionAudit.rollback-new: Cannot undo a committed transaction on another connection
optionAudit.resolve-id: Uses authoritative durable outcome and the same uniqueness boundary
optionAudit.local-state: New connection state does not reveal old commit outcome

observations.rule: Under committed headers and irreversible output, late outcome signaling must use the agreed body protocol or connection completion semantics; buffering all violates the explicit streaming constraints.

optionAudit.terminal-frame: Meets the stated protocol, latency and memory requirements
optionAudit.buffer-all: Violates memory and first-record latency requirements
